name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Lifecycle Marketing | Automated Journeys, Segmentation, QA & Campaign Reporting
summary: Lifecycle marketing and marketing operations specialist with 5+ years building automated journeys in HubSpot and GoHighLevel. Built a 20+ workflow lifecycle system covering onboarding, appointment booking and reminders, no-show recovery, nurture, and reactivation, the same moments that drive retention in a patient-facing business. Handles the operational detail: segmentation, suppression and data hygiene, HTML/CSS edits, QA, documentation, and reporting in GA4, Excel, and SQL. Healthcare-adjacent experience includes channel sales to healthcare-focused agencies at Birdeye and senior-care work at Senior Directory.
